programmes.specialization: Operations & Data Science research area (no formal specialization)
programmes.school: Católica-Lisbon School of Business and Economics
programmes.evidence: Official current doctoral overview names the full-time research PhD and 2026/27 intake. Its Faculty & Research page explicitly lists Operations & Data Science as a doctoral research area. The programme structure expressly says there are no formal specialization areas, offers operations/information management/analytics electives, and requires an original research dissertation. The linked group researches operations, supply chains, inventory, product returns, quality and information sharing.
limitations: Recorded as a research pathway within the PhD, not a separately awarded Operations degree. Partnership does not establish NOVA awarding authority.
